**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

**As Senior Product Development Associate, you'll lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new and improved products across multiple categories, helping mature JOE's global innovation pipeline as it scales. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, the role sits within the Menu & Innovation team, working closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners and Supply Chain. Reporting to the Global Menu & Innovation Director, this role manages projects from concept through to launch, ensuring delivery against quality, timings, brand standards, nutritional guardrails, and commercial goals. It combines shaping the global innovation agenda and 3-year menu vision with hands-on ownership of NPD and EPD projects from ideation to in-store launch, always keeping juicer ease at the heart. As part of the team steering JOE's innovation agenda, you'll have real scope to shape the future of our global menu.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own and evolve JOE's NPD and EPD pipeline, leading projects from concept through to launch against timings, budgets and briefs.

• Lead projects from ideation through internal approval, following the internal 'Joe' gate approval process and GreenLight governance.

• Translate concepts into scalable recipes for high-volume execution, developed within brand, quality and operational guardrails, keeping juicer ease at the heart.

• Lead all product testing and trials ahead of launch, including scale-up, product and commercial trials, across appropriate markets worldwide, for your projects.

• Deliver and own a structured calendar of seasonal LTOs and rotating products, aligned with portfolio strategy and commercial priorities.

• Own the innovation pipeline for assigned categories, with full project management ownership of cross-functional teams through the stage-gate process from brief to in-store launch.

• Partner with Operations, Marketing, Supply Chain, Training, Franchise and Compliance to coordinate critical paths and ensure launch readiness.

• Drive communication of product strategy and innovation recommendations to senior leadership, and act as the trend and competitor go-to expert for assigned categories.

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels.

• Strong project management experience, comfortable owning multiple critical paths and timings at once.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 4 years' experience in a corporate product development role, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant).

• Hands-on coffee development and product ownership experience.

• Familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance is a plus.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

• Knowledge of carbon credit and allowance allocation is a plus.

• Experience and interest in climate, sustainability or carbon markets is highly valued.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

Job level (internal scale): Level 8 - Junior Expert (A developing professional who demonstrates potential and aptitude in a specific area of expertise. They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

What to include in your application

• Your CV and a short cover letter (PDF) - please highlight in the Cover Letter how you are combining finance and data or automations in your work

• Please leave out photos and identifying characteristics such as age, gender, nationality, etc.

Our hiring process

• 30 min intro interview with our People & Culture Partner

• Interview and short assignment or case with CFO + a team member

The final candidate will have:

• Reference check

• Final conversation with our CEO, Mads Emil

• Offer

How to apply: If you're interested in the role, please apply by filling in this form and selecting “Finance Manager - Data & BI”.

Equal Opportunities

Klimate is committed to equal opportunities for all people and ideas.

Even if you think you don’t meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply.

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and strive to ensure an objective selection process.

Please leave out your date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, photo, and other personal characteristics from your CV and application.

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, GCP Inspection Office, R&D Quality
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**R&D Quality encompasses four teams GCLP/GLP Quality, PV Quality, Audit Calibration, Quality and GCP Quality. R&D Quality has a large range of stakeholders, and we have an important role in delivering our 2030 vision to transform the future of cancer treatment.

In the role as AD GCP Inspection Office you will be driving day-to-day GCP Quality activities including audit together with a dedicated and highly skilled team. Furthermore, you will be taking up the role as GCP Inspection QA lead.

The role requires profound understanding of how the GCP requirements are applied into practice, especially with focus on the European requirements and interpretation of ICH GCP R3 and Computerized Systems in Clinical Trials.

The role includes hands on GCP Quality activities such as support to our many stakeholders as well as performing audits alone or together with own team members or with support from neighbouring teams. You become a key member of the R&D Quality leadership team that together drives people engagement, setting strategies and ensuring R&D Quality deliverables.

The role requires strong collaboration capabilities in an international setting across various QA departments as well across the company with target stakeholders such as Clinical Trial Operations, Clinical Data, Integration & Reporting, Digital Development, Medical, GDS&PV, and Regulatory Affairs.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Reporting to Director and Team Lead Inspection Office R&D Quality

• It will ensure GCP inspection readiness across cross functional clinical -study team.

• The role oversees end-of-end inspection planning and execution including logistics and stakeholder coordination.

• Lead and oversee GCP inspection readiness/preparation activities and serve as an inspection lead for regulatory health authority inspection including but not limited to US FDA, MHRA, EMA, CFDI, PMDA etc.

• Collaborate with the cross functional clinical study teams to develop and execute and integrated risk-based inspection readiness/preparation strategy ensuring consistent alignment across functions.

• Manage end to end inspection readiness/preparation activities, including development and maintenance of inspection storyboards with the SMEs, proactive identification and mitigation of the inspection related risk and planning, facilitation.

• Lead the mock inspections for high-risk trials across Genmab locations.

• During the inspection coordinate and assign inspection requests to appropriate SMEs providing oversight and appropriate SME, also guide to ensure timely and effective responses.

• Create/revise appropriate tools / SOPs for inspection readiness/preparation and management.

• Ensure Veeva records are updated for inspection records or related records.

• Demonstrate ability to solve complex problems requiring in-depth evaluation of various factors.

• Fulfill inspection commitments and respond to the inspection and carry out post inspection activities.

• Maintain a central repository of global inspection status and updates

• Meticulous attention to detail, excellent review skills and ability to independently manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Support/manage site inspection in collaboration with GCP Quality.

• Lead and facilitate post-inspection lessons learned session to trends, share best practices and drive sustainable process improvements.

**Requirements

**

• MS, or BS or similar in Natural Science

• 10+ years of experience in a GCP Quality function or similar

• Deep expertise in GCP processes and the EMA, PMDA and FDA requirements.

• Demonstrated leadership in regulatory inspections and health authority interactions.

• Considered to be a Domain Expert within GCP by peers with a strong interest and ability to educate others

• Experience as Lead Auditor within GCP is an advantage

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK732.768,00---1.099.152,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Our Quality Systems team is looking for a new colleague to strengthen our Supplier Quality Management team at AGC Biologics in Søborg.

Are you interested in supplier quality, GMP compliance and working with internal and external partners in a complex pharmaceutical environment? Do you enjoy working with quality processes, assessments and continuous improvement? Then you may be the colleague we are looking for.

About The Role

As a Supplier Quality Management Specialist, you will join a dedicated team currently consisting of a Scientist and a Senior Scientist. The team supports site manufacturing of clinical and commercial drug substances and is responsible for ensuring that our suppliers meet the required quality standards and regulatory expectations.

You will work with different aspects of Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualifications, assessments and evaluations, supplier audits, and Supplier Quality Agreements. You will also support the site as a subject matter expert during client audits and regulatory inspections.

We are looking for someone who is interested in supplier management, willing to learn and motivated to contribute to a busy and complex environment. The role requires attention to detail, a pragmatic approach to quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Depending on your experience and qualifications, the position may be filled at Specialist or Senior Specialist level.

Your Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supplier Management: Participate in and manage supplier qualification, assessments and ongoing performance evaluations to ensure suppliers meet AGC Biologics' quality requirements.

• Supplier Audits: Support the planning, preparation and execution of supplier audits. If you are already a trained or certified lead auditor, you may take a leading role in conducting audits. If not, auditor training and development can be part of your development plan.

• Quality Agreements: Prepare, review, negotiate and maintain Supplier Quality Agreements with internal and external partners.

• Audit and Inspection Support: Support the site as a subject matter expert on supplier quality matters during client audits and regulatory inspections.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Material Science, Quality Control, Supply Chain Management and other functional areas at the site, as well as colleagues across AGC's global network.

• Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and improvement of supplier quality processes and the site's quality management system.

About The Quality Systems Department

Supplier Quality Management (SQM) is part of the Quality Systems department and plays an important role within the site's Quality organisation.

You will join a diverse team of highly qualified colleagues with extensive experience in Quality Assurance. The team works closely with Material Science,

Quality Control and Supply Chain Management, as well as partners across all functional areas at the site.

We also collaborate with other AGC sites globally to ensure that quality-related activities are carried out effectively, efficiently and in compliance with cGMP requirements.

We value open communication, professionalism and a collaborative approach. Our goal is to provide high-quality support to colleagues across AGC Biologics, our customers and our suppliers.

You will report to the Manager of the Supplier Quality Management team.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a colleague who is detail-oriented, pragmatic and comfortable working with quality requirements in a regulated environment.

As a Person, You Have

• The ability to be pragmatic and still ensure compliance.

• Proven technical writing skills.

• Skills in verbal communications. Ability to respond to complex inquiries from customers, co-workers, and suppliers.

• Skilled in time and priority management.

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively to accomplish deadlines and objectives.

You Also Have

• Minimum 2 years prior working experience in a Biotech/Pharmaceutical environment, with a focus on supplier quality.

• Master’s degree in pharmacy, biochemistry, or related life sciences field.

• Strong knowledge of GMP guidelines, as well as international regulations, pertaining to the production of biopharmaceutical products (including, but not limited to 21 CFR Parts 11, 210, 211, 600, and 610; EU GMP Parts I, II, and III, and relevant ICH guidelines).

• Experienced lead auditor (e.g.: ISO 9001, GMP) is an advantage but not a requirement.

If you do not have lead auditor training or certification, this can be part of your professional development.

What We Offer

At AGC Biologics, you will become part of an international organisation where quality, collaboration and continuous improvement are essential to what we do.

We Offer

• An international working environment with opportunities for professional development and collaboration across global sites.

• Competitive employment conditions, including salary, bonus schemes, pension and health insurance.

• Opportunities for training, development and cross-functional knowledge sharing.

• A strong focus on work-life balance, employee well-being and a supportive working environment.

• A variety of company and Employee Club activities in Copenhagen.

• A flexible and trust-based working culture with an open and collaborative approach.

• The opportunity to contribute to our purpose: Bringing Hope to Life.

How To Apply

Please submit your application and CV through the AGC Biologics career site. We do not accept applications by email.

Deadline: 29 November.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

_Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_We look forward to receiving your application!

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

**What You Will Do

**_Drive retail campaign experiences

_

• Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

_Lead global campaign toolkits

_

• Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

_Lead and develop creative talent

_

• Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

_Partner across the business

_

• Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

_Deliver from concept to execution

_

• Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

**Who You Are

**You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

**We imagine you bring

**

• Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• Professional fluency in English.

**What Will Make You Stand Out

**A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

Do you want to lead 10 engineers building a Legal-Tech SaaS platform on .NET and Azure?

At Epona in Vejle, you will lead the engineering organization behind our Legal-Tech SaaS platform, used by more than 800 law firms and corporate legal departments worldwide. Our platform is built with .NET 10, C#, Azure services, REST APIs and semantic search.

You will combine people leadership with accountability for reliable delivery, engineering quality and continuous improvement, while helping Epona transition from its existing solution to the next-generation SaaS platform.

Your teams

You will be responsible for 10 engineers in Vejle, organized in three teams:

• Two agile product development teams, one working on our new SaaS platform and one on the on-premise solution it replaces

• One platform team of two DevOps engineers, owning CI/CD, infrastructure (Terraform) and cloud operations

How we work with AI

AI is part of how we work, both as product capabilities and as tooling in our engineering workflow. We use Claude as a coding companion to accelerate product delivery and improve quality. We expect you to drive effective and critical use of AI tools across your teams.

Promote responsible AI adoption, including security, code review, testing and appropriate human oversight. Assess its impact on delivery speed, quality and developer effectiveness rather than measuring usage alone.

Your role

As the Head of Engineering, your primary focus is on people leadership and delivering results through your teams. You bring a strong technical background that enables you to challenge technical decisions, contribute to architectural discussions and ensure engineering quality. You report to the CTO.

• Lead, coach and develop 10 engineers through 1:1s, feedback and career development

• Set clear expectations, provide regular performance feedback, address underperformance and develop succession and capability plans.

• Make AI tools like Claude part of how the teams work, and measure the effect on delivery

• Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery with Product Management, including AI-powered capabilities in our platform

• Translate agreed product priorities into realistic engineering commitments; make risks, dependencies, trade-offs and capacity constraints visible early.

• Use relevant indicators such as lead time, delivery predictability, defect trends, reliability and incident resolution to drive improvement, not reporting for its own sake.

• Drive technical direction and engineering quality together with architects and senior engineers

• Strengthen automated testing, security, scalability, maintainability, CI/CD and management of technical debt.

• Collaborate with international colleagues and shape team structure and ways of working across product and platform teams

• Partner with Operations and Support to identify recurring customer issues, reduce avoidable incidents and feed insights into engineering and product improvements.

• Communicate decisions, progress and risks transparently and follow through on agreed actions across teams.

• Own how and how well we deliver, including technical trade-offs and delivery commitments. The Project Manager owns what we deliver and why. Timelines are agreed jointly by trading off scope, time and quality, with escalation to CPO and CTO.

• Stay technically involved through occasional code reviews and technical contributions, while playing a key role in architectural decisions alongside architects and senior engineers. The primary focus remains on leading the engineering teams rather than individual coding.

Measuring success

Success will be measured through improvements in AI adoption and impact, engineering delivery and quality, team engagement and retention, and collaboration with Product Management and Operations.

Within the first 60 days, you will establish baselines and agree measurable 6- and 12-month improvement targets with the CTO.

How you lead – Epona values

Epona’s five values guide how we lead, make decisions and work together. The Engineering Manager is expected to demonstrate them through visible behaviour, not just words.

• One Team — Build a shared identity across Engineering, Product, Operations and Support. Break down silos, actively help colleagues, and put shared outcomes ahead of “them and us” thinking.

• Customer First — Make quality and delivery central to engineering decisions. Understand customer impact, address recurring issues and prioritise reliable outcomes for customers.

**Turn scientific promise into clinical progress. Build the proof-of-concept engine that helps LEO Pharma make smarter development decisions and bring meaningful innovation closer to patients.

****Shape What Comes Next

**How would you connect emerging biology, quantitative insights, and clinical expertise to shape the next generation of development programs? At LEO Pharma, you will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, bringing together people, partners, and evidence to answer critical questions early. This is an opportunity to build capabilities, influence portfolio decisions, and connect scientific ambition with a clear path to clinical proof of concept.

**Your role

**You will build and lead an integrated proof-of-concept engine, translating biological hypotheses into clinically testable, quantitatively informed, decision-ready programs. Working across internal teams and external partners, you will establish mechanism-based rationales, meaningful patient strategies, and robust development plans. Your focus will be on generating the evidence needed to select doses, assess benefit–risk, and guide progression toward registrational studies.

Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Lead translational and early-development strategy across programs, developing people leaders and subject-matter experts.

• Partner with Science, Search & Innovation and clinical teams to design early-phase studies demonstrating target engagement, proof of mechanism, and patient relevance.

• Integrate biomarkers, patient stratification, quantitative pharmacology, and modelling and simulation to optimize doses, regimens, endpoints, and study designs.

• Support clinical due diligence and integration of externally sourced assets, building partnerships that strengthen translational capabilities.

• Shape regulatory and cross-functional evidence strategies, translating complex findings into clear recommendations for project teams and governance forums.

You will also establish progression criteria and performance indicators that strengthen decision quality, evidence maturity, execution, and resource efficiency. Throughout early development, you will ensure efficacy hypotheses are considered alongside safety, tolerability, and therapeutic index.

**Your Qualifications

**You bring scientific depth and leadership experience, with the ability to connect translational evidence to clinical and portfolio decisions.

We are looking for:

• An advanced degree in Medicine, Pharmacology, Translational Science, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline; MD and PhD qualifications are preferred.

• Significant leadership experience in translational medicine, clinical pharmacology, and/or early clinical development within biotech or pharma.

• Demonstrated expertise in early-phase studies in patients and healthy participants, linking mechanisms of action and biomarkers to dose selection and development strategy.

• A track record of building high-performing global teams, developing people, and integrating external assets and partnerships.

• Experience contributing to regulatory submissions and evidence generation supporting registration and market access.

Experience with externally sourced innovation is strongly preferred; dermatology and/or rare-disease experience is beneficial. You combine strategic thinking with curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative approach, influencing effectively across a matrix organization.

**Your new team

**You will lead Translational Medicine & Early Development, with two line managers as direct reports, the group is in total 20 employees. You will report to the Vice President, Head of Global Clinical Development.

Your network will span clinical development, skin science, regulatory, safety, market access, and commercial colleagues. Together with external collaborators, you will connect expertise across disciplines to strengthen early development.

**Contact and application

**For additional information, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Sabina Ravn Lebech at saleb@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

**

• Implement and refine production processes and tools, shaping how we work and grow as a studio

• Drive the project forward by removing roadblocks and keeping delivery dates realistic

• Facilitate the team’s day-to-day rhythm (stand-ups, planning, reviews, post-mortems)
